Reading this map

Kernel density estimate (quartic kernel) — crossings per km² on a fixed scale. Bandwidth sets how localized the density is (lower = sharper peaks); Detail sharpens the rendering only. The surface is masked to the study-area boundary, so nothing shows over water or outside the ZIPs.

Hover a cell for its count. One value per fixed-geometry cell. Cells are kept when their center is inside the boundary. For an index, rebuild the tessellation in ArcGIS with zero-count cells and join.
